description: This Java class 'PriceServices' provides methods related to product pricing calculations within the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes functions for calculating product prices based on rules, conditions, and actions, retrieving and filtering price entities, and applying taxes. It serves as a core utility class for managing product pricing logic, including handling virtual products, price overrides, and currency conversions.

classes.name: PriceServices
classes.description: Utility class for product price calculations, including retrieving price data, applying rules, and handling currency conversions within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: calculateProductPrice
methods.description: Calculates the product price based on various parameters, applying pricing rules, overrides, and taxes; handles virtual products and currency conversions.

methods.name: addGeneralResults
methods.description: Adds common pricing and tax-related results to the output map, including VAT calculation if applicable.

methods.name: makeProducePriceRuleList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of applicable product price rules, optimized for large or small rule sets, based on various filtering conditions.

methods.name: calcPriceResultFromRules
methods.description: Evaluates a list of price rules to compute the final price, considering conditions, actions, and everyday constraints like min/max prices.

methods.name: getPriceValueForType
methods.description: Fetches specific price value entities (e.g., LIST_PRICE, PROMO_PRICE) from a list, supporting fallback to secondary lists.

methods.name: calcPriceResultFromRules
methods.description: Evaluates a list of price rules to compute the final price, considering conditions, actions, and constraints like min/max prices.
